name: Should I accept the first insurance offer after a car accident injury?

mainEntity.name: Should I accept the first insurance offer after a car accident injury?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is rarely wise—insurance offers are often low. A lawyer helps negotiate for fair compensation and reviews settlement terms before acceptance.selfhelp.courts.ca+1​
